_comment: The wire contract for an umbrella area: the exact coverage header lines plan+apply emit, one per sub-roadmap, from README.md, the sub-roadmap READMEs and status-body.md. Checked by hand against TauCeti's scripts/roadmap_progress.py at `consumer_revision`: read_roadmaps gave RootSystems and SchurWeyl their states from these markers, refused SchurWeyl's after its README was edited, and the umbrella row stayed no-layers. The consumer before that revision ignores these lines. Regenerate only when the wire format changes, and record the consumer revision checked.
